Hit follow and share your most UNHINGED tip! Automation comes last, not first. Asking AI for an answer is stage 1. The work gets more useful when you use AI to test ideas, learn your process, and handle bigger jobs with clear rules. The 5 stages: 1. Ask AI: Get an answer. 2. Think with AI: Find gaps in your ideas. 3. Teach AI: Show it how you like work done. 4. Delegate to AI: Give it a meaningful assignment. 5. Automate with AI: Have it repeat the work on a schedule. At stage 2, ask AI to find blind spots and question whether the work needs to exist. At stage 3, give AI context, examples, rules, and feedback. Let it ask questions. Check the output, then save your process as a reusable skill. At stage 4, give AI a real job with several files. Check every figure and piece of evidence before you trust the result. At stage 5, schedule a reliable skill. Start with drafts for human review. Add tools or connectors when the job needs fresh data. These 6 prompt add-ons help AI ask better questions, copy your taste, spot weak thinking, and check its work. 1. ELI10 Add this when an answer feels too hard. ChatGPT will explain the idea in simple terms. 2. Before you answer, ask me 5 clarifying questions. Use this when your request needs more detail. Your answers give ChatGPT the context it needs. 3. Here's examples I like: [examples] Paste samples you like and dislike. AI gets a clear target instead of guessing. 4. Turn this chat into a reusable skill. This turns your working chat into instructions for later. You won't need to repeat the full setup. 5. Find my blind spots and weak assumptions Ask this before you trust the answer. It pushes AI to challenge your logic instead of praising every idea. 6. Keep improving this until it meets these RULES. Check your work against each rule before saying you're done.
